name: omp-qol-plugin
description: Quality-of-life plugin for the omp (Oh My Pi) coding agent: agent goal tool + agent-controlled plan/vibe modes

scripts.test: bun test test/goal-tool.test.ts && bun test test/mode-tool.test.ts && bun test test/host-bridge.test.ts && bun test test/integration-real-session.test.ts && bun test test/advisor-tool.test.ts && bun test test/advisor-integration.test.ts

greeting.description: Notification text shown when a session starts

notifyOnSessionStart.description: Show the greeting notification on session start

goalToolEnabled.description: Register the always-available agent goal tool (QOL-001)

modeToolEnabled.description: Register the agent-controlled plan/vibe mode tool (QOL-002/003)
